reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 15 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Thunder.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 89 times in 100, by about 15; most games like this end between 205 and 253 total points.
